findings.title: No Authentication or Authorization on Entire API
findings.remediation: Add global JWT authentication middleware before all route handlers. Implement login endpoint. Add RBAC requireRole() middleware per route. Thread actor identity from token through all mutating operations.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass — Multiple Paths to Approve Without Assessment
findings.remediation: Remove status from PATCH-able fields. Gate force-approve behind admin role with precondition (min 1 completed voting round). Gate overrideRoute on privilege check. Add invariant tests for assessment pod bypass detection.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Bulk Data Deletion (Permanent, No Recovery)
findings.remediation: Require authentication on all DELETE operations. Implement soft-delete with deleted_at column. Add privileged hard-purge endpoint behind admin role. Add rate limiting on DELETE routes.

findings.title: Ghost-Blocker DoS — Deleted Blocker Permanently Freezes Dependent Item
findings.remediation: On item deletion, cascade-remove all dependency edges where item is a blocker. Fix computeHasUnresolvedBlockers() to treat undefined blocker as resolved. Add periodic dependency audit job for orphaned references.

findings.title: No Pagination Enforcement — Full Dataset Extraction in Single Request
findings.remediation: Clamp limit: Math.min(Math.max(1, parseInt(...) || 20), 100). Add LIMIT/OFFSET to all SQL list queries in portal/Backend. Return {data, total, page, limit, totalPages} for all list endpoints.

findings.title: Stored XSS — HTML/Script Payloads Stored Verbatim
findings.remediation: Sanitize all free-text inputs server-side using isomorphic-dompurify or strict character allowlist. Ensure frontend HTML-encodes dynamic content before DOM insertion. Add Content-Security-Policy header via helmet().

findings.title: Unauthenticated Bulk Dependency Replacement via PATCH
findings.remediation: Require authentication. Gate dependency modification behind reviewer/dispatcher role. Separate blockedBy mutation into a dedicated, audited endpoint.

findings.title: Cascade Dispatch Exploit — Force Auto-Dispatch via Reject-After-Approve
findings.remediation: onItemResolved() cascade dispatch must validate team name and require same authorization checks as explicit /dispatch endpoint.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Verification
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 against shared secret in env var. Add Authorization: Bearer <INTAKE_API_KEY> check on /automated. Reject non-matching requests with 401.

findings.title: Required SOC2 Audit Events Not Emitted
findings.remediation: Create auditLog({event, actor, target, timestamp, outcome, ip}) function. Emit login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition (with real actor from token), and data_export events.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Install helmet, add app.use(helmet()). Document TLS at infra layer in CLAUDE.md. Add middleware rejecting requests where X-Forwarded-Proto !== https in production.

findings.title: Prometheus /metrics Publicly Accessible
findings.remediation: Restrict to internal network via reverse proxy, or add bearer token check (METRICS_TOKEN env var), or expose on separate non-public port.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Leaked to API Clients
findings.remediation: Replace res.status(500).json({ error: message }) with res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' }) in all catch blocks.

findings.title: Intake Webhook Enum Validation Bypass
findings.remediation: Add enum validation in both intake routes before createWorkItem(), mirroring pattern in workItems.ts lines 29-41.

findings.title: No CORS Policy / Missing Security Headers
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors; add app.use(helmet()); app.use(cors({ origin: 'http://localhost:5173' })); before route registration.

findings.title: Sequential Predictable Document IDs Enable Enumeration
findings.remediation: Use random suffixes for docId generation, or accept and document the information-disclosure risk.

findings.title: NaN/Negative Pagination — Response Oracle
findings.remediation: Add isNaN guard: const page = isNaN(rawPage) || rawPage < 1 ? 1 : rawPage; const limit = Math.min(Math.max(1, rawLimit || 20), 100).

findings.title: No Actor Identity in Operational Logs or Change History
findings.remediation: Thread real actor identity from auth token through all service calls. Add requestId middleware via AsyncLocalStorage. Replace hardcoded actor strings with authenticated user ID.

findings.title: No Hard Delete / Right to Erasure Mechanism
findings.remediation: Implement purgeWorkItem(id) removing item from Map entirely. Expose as privileged admin endpoint behind RBAC. Document retention policy.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Install express-rate-limit. Apply global limiter (100 req/min per IP) and tighter limiter on intake and state-transition endpoints (10 req/min per IP).

findings.title: No Length Validation on Free-Text Fields
findings.remediation: Add maxLength validation: title <= 200, description <= 10000 chars in all creation and update routes.

findings.title: No Correlation/Trace IDs in Log Entries
findings.remediation: Integrate @opentelemetry/sdk-node or pino serializers. Add request middleware that extracts/generates traceparent and injects traceId/spanId into all log entries via AsyncLocalStorage.
